_what: A room brought onto the street by tools/import-room.py from an artifact somebody built with their own AI. Everything here is read off that artifact's FOR THE STREET comment or measured from the room as it renders; nothing is typed. check-contrast.py holds the pairs, check-jukebox.py checks the tracks, and re-importing replaces this file whole.
title: The Sandbox
description: A sandbox at dusk, lit by a laptop left open in the sand: come in curious, try things, break things and give feedback, with no deadlines and nothing to lose.
name: Norah
light: A laptop left open in the sand at dusk, its screen the only light in the playground.
words: The idea of the room, who it is for, and its intent (curiosity, feedback, no deadlines, no fear of breaking anything, no outcome needed, meeting in the middle, spoons) are Norah's own words; Claude reworded them into the opening and "Come on in" as drafts for Norah to change. Claude drafted the "Two sandboxes" paragraph, the castle instructions, the suggestion box words and the credits. The quoted sentence is from Wikipedia.
built_with: Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic
